description: Land on Dashboard (and fatten it) instead of the Graph, which is unreadable at default zoom (use a fit-to-readable initial zoom); remove or repurpose the permanently-inert 'Select a feature to see status.' global bar shown atop every view; and resolve the three competing status models on one item (status dropdown vs lifecycle phase vs confidence) so it is clear which governs `compose build` (see COMP-AUDIT-11).
